Frustrated with RMA Rejection – G4 Instant Failed Just Past 1 Year Warranty
Hey everyone, I wanted to share my recent experience and also see if UniFi’s team here can help escalate this.

I had a **UVC-G4-INS-EU** camera fail just slightly past its **1-year warranty**. I submitted an RMA request, but it was unfortunately rejected. The response I received stated that devices purchased from third-party distributors only carry 1-year coverage, while direct Ubiquiti purchases get 2 years.

What’s frustrating is that this camera was installed **indoors, in a standard corner with normal conditions — no heat exposure, nothing unusual**. It still failed just after one year.

This feels disappointing because:

* Many cheaper cameras I’ve bought for **$30–50 have lasted me years** without issues.
* I paid a **premium price** for UniFi because of the ecosystem and quality, yet this camera barely made it past a year.
* I currently manage **three sites running UniFi gear**, so it’s disheartening to see a premium product fail so soon with no repair option or goodwill support.

I’ve invested heavily in UniFi products because I believe in the ecosystem, but experiences like this make it harder to justify future investments.

I hope UniFi can reconsider how cases like this are handled whether through an expedited replacement, repair path, or a gesture of goodwill.

Has anyone else faced this kind of issue with UniFi hardware failing just past warranty?

**TL;DR**: Paid premium for UniFi camera, used indoors under normal conditions, failed just past 1 year. RMA rejected. Meanwhile, my $30–50 budget cams are still running after years. Frustrated as I run 3 UniFi sites and expected better support.
